note: One entry per package in requirements.lock, at the locked version. 'license' is the SPDX expression read from the package's own metadata (checked by `python -m app.deps_check installed`). Update this file whenever requirements.lock changes; `python -m app.deps_check lock` fails until it matches.

allowed_why.MIT: permissive: use, change and ship freely; keep the notice
allowed_why.MIT-0: MIT without even the notice requirement
allowed_why.BSD-3-Clause: permissive, like MIT, plus: don't use the authors' names to promote your product
allowed_why.Apache-2.0: permissive, plus a patent grant; keep notices and say what you changed
allowed_why.PSF-2.0: the Python Software Foundation's permissive license
allowed_why.MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft: using it unchanged is fine; changes to its own files must be shared under MPL-2.0

annotated-doc.why: used by fastapi for parameter descriptions

annotated-types.why: used by pydantic for value limits

anyio.why: async plumbing under starlette, httpx and watchfiles

certifi.why: trusted HTTPS root certificates for httpx (used unchanged)

cffi.why: lets cryptography call its compiled code

colorama.why: coloured terminal output for click and pytest; Windows only

cryptography.why: Ed25519 signatures for jobs, reports and key handovers

fastapi.why: web framework for the coordinator API

h11.why: HTTP/1.1 parsing for uvicorn and httpcore

httpx.why: HTTP client for the demo worker, tests and tools

iniconfig.why: pytest reads its settings with it (tests only)

opentelemetry-api.why: pulled in by fastapi; the prototype sends no telemetry

packaging.why: version rules for pytest and for this checker

pydantic.why: checks every job, receipt and request shape

typing-extensions.why: newer type hints for pydantic, fastapi and anyio

typing-inspection.why: used by pydantic to read type hints

uvloop.why: faster event loop for uvicorn; not on Windows

websockets.why: uvicorn's websocket support (the API doesn't use websockets)
